## [Events]{style="color:#D6BF91;"}

::: {#events}

```{=html}
<script>
// Click an event picture to see it full size; click anywhere or press Esc to close.
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  var img = e.target.closest("#listing-events .thumbnail img");
  if (!img) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  var box = document.createElement("div");
  box.className = "event-lightbox";
  box.innerHTML = '<img alt="">';
  box.firstChild.src = img.currentSrc || img.src;
  box.firstChild.alt = img.alt;
  function close() {
    box.remove();
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }
  function onKey(ev) { if (ev.key === "Escape") close(); }
  box.addEventListener("click", close);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  document.body.appendChild(box);
});
</script>
```
